title: 我们的北马丨2026北马参赛指南（组委会发布，中国新闻网转载全文）
publisher: 北京马拉松组委会（“北京马拉松”微信公众号）
claims: The official guide publishes a cut-off table: 5 km at 08:25, 10 km at 09:00, 15 km at 09:40, 20 km at 10:20, half marathon at 10:30, 25 km at 11:00, 30 km at 11:45, 35 km at 12:30 and the finish at 13:30, all Beijing time.
Cut-offs are set by kilometre point and roads reopen to traffic as each cut-off passes; runners behind the cut-off must leave the course.
The official guide publishes a course service table at 5, 7.5, 10, 12.5, 15, 17.5, 20, 22.5, 25, 27.5, 30, 32.5, 35, 37.5 and 40 km.
In that table, refreshment stations are marked at 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40 km — eight in total.
Drinking and sponging stations are marked at 7.5, 12.5, 17.5, 22.5, 27.5, 32.5 and 37.5 km — seven in total.
Food supply is marked at 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 32.5 and 37.5 km — seven in total.
Refreshment stations alternate drinking water and sports drink; drinking and sponging stations alternate drinking water and wet sponges.
Timing mats sit at the start, every 5 km, at the half-marathon point, at the turnaround points and at the finish; a missing timing point means no ranking.
The start area opens at 05:30 and closes to entry at 07:20; bib check runs 05:30–07:30 and bag drop 05:30–7:15.
Finish baggage collection closes at 14:30 on race day.
Toilets are placed at 1, 2, 3 and 4 km, every 2.5 km from 5 km to the finish, and additionally at 14 km and 16 km.
The 2026 toilet provision totals 1,630 places across start, course and finish, a ratio of one toilet per 20 runners.
Fixed medical stations run every 2.5 km from 5 km to 32.5 km inclusive, then every 1 km from 34 km to the finish, with fixed stations at start and finish.
Start access: metro Line 2 Hepingmen exit B, 20–30 minutes on foot; Line 2 Qianmen exits B/C or Line 8 Qianmen exits E/I/G, 20–25 minutes on foot.

Finish access: walk south from the finish area to metro Line 8 Olympic Sports Center exit B2; a free shuttle runs from the east side of exit D on Beichen Road to Beitucheng (Lines 8 and 10) for runners wearing a race bib.
The official forecast for race day 18 October 2026 was clear with visibility above 10 km, northerly wind around force 3 with gusts to force 5, and 14–19 C between 07:00 and 14:00.
The official forecast expected 35–50 mm of steady rain across the city on 17 October, the day before the race.
Red self-supply tables are reserved for invited and championship athletes; mass runners taking anything from them are disqualified.
The race issues a reusable cup and provides multi-tap self-service water drums and backpack-style water units at service points.
The official race pages and this guide present the course as maps and images; no downloadable GPX or KML file is offered.
